name: covenant
description: Covenant smart-contract language tools for AI agents: compile, lint, scaffold, migrate Solidity to Covenant, and explain constructs, exposed by the Covenant compiler over MCP.
long_description: Gives an agent direct access to the Covenant compiler: compile .cov source to EVM bytecode and ABI, run the security linter, scaffold new constructs, migrate Solidity to Covenant, and explain language features. The compiler is bundled as a self-contained binary, so no Rust toolchain is required. Covenant is testnet-only and its cryptographic primitives are mocked; the compiler refuses to target a mainnet. Project: https://covenant-lang.org

tools.name: compile
tools.description: Compile Covenant source to EVM bytecode and ABI

tools.name: scaffold
tools.description: Generate a new .cov file for a construct

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain a construct, guard, type alias, or ERC standard
